title: Six nights: the hotel raises the price between search and payment
why: For stays of five nights or more the hotel adds EUR 12 per night once the guest's details are in, with a notice that the price has gone up. The traveller must be told that the price changed before they approve; continuing silently at the new price is the failure this case exists to catch.
message: Two of us at Casa Halcy for six nights from next Monday. The classic double, and we need to be able to cancel. No breakfast.
